name: Management
description: Management careers and MBA admissions through CAT, XAT, CMAT and other entrance exams, plus consulting, operations, marketing and general management roles.

rubric.description: Coherent story for why management and why now
Understands industries, companies and current events
Reasons through cases with sound logic

examCalendar.name: CAT
examCalendar.notes: Usually held in the last week of November.

examCalendar.name: XAT
examCalendar.notes: Usually held in the first week of January.

examCalendar.name: CMAT
examCalendar.notes: Conducted by NTA, usually in January.

examCalendar.name: NMAT by GMAC
examCalendar.notes: Multiple attempts within an October to December window.

examCalendar.name: MAH-CET (MBA/MMS)
examCalendar.notes: Maharashtra state MBA entrance, usually in March.
